passages.title: Air purifier care · Document 1
passages.text: Thank you for purchasing a Bellmont air purifier. For reliable performance, replace the filter {{1}} six months. Use an {{2}} service center for repairs covered by the warranty. Customers {{3}} need help identifying the correct filter can contact our support team with the model number. {{4}}

passages.title: Question Ocean · P6-G35 · Document 1
passages.text:
FACILITIES MEMORANDUM

Technicians have observed irregular temperature readings from the east-wing cooling unit. The unit will be temporarily {{1}} on Thursday evening so that its sensors can be inspected. Although the backup unit can support the current workload, engineers recommend moving nonurgent batch jobs to after midnight, {{2}} demand is normally lowest. {{3}} Supervisors should therefore confirm that every team has {{4}} the revised processing schedule before 3:00 P.M. on Thursday.

passages.title: Community hall repair fund · Document 1
passages.text:
COMMUNITY UPDATE

Funds {{1}} during the spring campaign will repair the hall roof. The estimate includes essential waterproofing but does not {{2}} optional interior decoration. We will publish invoices {{3}} the work is completed so donors can see how the money was used. {{4}}

passages.title: Meeting assistant pilot · Document 1
passages.text: Cascade Labs will trial a meeting assistant that produces {{1}} summaries. It may be used only after every participant has {{2}} consent. Recordings are deleted automatically unless a project manager {{3}} a longer retention period under the approved policy. Consent must be checked for each meeting, including newly invited guests. {{4}}

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R20 · Document 1
passages.text:
From: Hannah Brooks
To: Sales Staff
Subject: Friday Product Demonstration

The product demonstration scheduled for Friday will now begin at 1:30 P.M., thirty minutes later than originally planned. The client requested extra time to tour our warehouse before the presentation. Please update your calendars and arrive in Conference Room 2 by 1:15. Printed handouts will be available at the entrance.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R28 · Document 1
passages.text:
From: Daniel Reed
To: Office Staff
Subject: Printer Replacement

The color printer beside Meeting Room A will be replaced on Wednesday morning. Please send any urgent color print jobs to the second-floor copy center before Tuesday at 5 P.M. The new printer should be ready for use by Wednesday afternoon. Instructions for connecting to it will be posted on the employee portal.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R15 · Document 1
passages.text:
From: Victor Chen
To: Product Development Team
Subject: Prototype Review

The client has asked us to move Friday's prototype review from the downtown office to its manufacturing facility. The meeting will still begin at 10 A.M., but security registration may take up to twenty minutes. Please arrive by 9:30 and bring a government-issued photo ID. I have attached a map showing the visitor entrance and parking area.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R02 · Document 1
passages.text:
Harbor View Business Hotel
Weekend Conference Package

Reserve a meeting room for Saturday or Sunday and receive:
• Complimentary wireless Internet
• Coffee service for up to 20 guests
• A 15 percent discount on guest rooms
• Free parking for the event organizer

Reservations must be made at least ten days in advance. Call 555-0184 or visit harborviewhotel. example.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R79 · Document 1
passages.text:
DOCUMENT 1 — FACILITY NOTICE

The North Annex will be closed from August 12 through August 16 while its ventilation controls are replaced. Evening workshops normally held there will move to the Harbor Room, except for the August 14 tax seminar, which will be streamed online only. Desk reservations that extend past 6:00 P.M. will be shortened automatically, and fees for the canceled hours will be returned.

DOCUMENT 2 — PROGRAM SCHEDULE

August 13, 6:30 P.M. — Resume Clinic — North Annex
August 14, 7:00 P.M. — Small-Business Tax Seminar — North Annex
August 16, 6:00 P.M. — Founder Networking Session — North Annex

DOCUMENT 3 — E-MAIL

From: Dana Wu
To: Member Services
Subject: August 14 reservation

I reserved a desk in the North Annex from 5:00 to 8:00 P.M. on August 14 so I could finish a client proposal and then attend the tax seminar. I understand that the building work affects the evening, but I am unsure whether the desk area closes before 6:00. Please confirm how much of my reservation remains and where I should go for the seminar.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R07 · Document 1
passages.text:
Digital Content Coordinator

Pine & Row Publishing is seeking a detail-oriented coordinator to manage website updates and prepare weekly newsletters. Candidates should have at least two years of experience with content management systems and strong written communication skills. Familiarity with basic HTML is preferred but not required. The position is full-time and includes health insurance, paid leave, and a transportation allowance. Applications received by March 18 will receive priority consideration.

passages.title: Community kitchen hire · Document 1
passages.text:
KITCHEN HIRE CONDITIONS
The community kitchen fee includes normal electricity use and standard cleaning materials. Hirers must remove food waste and leave surfaces clear; the fee does not cover washing personal utensils left behind. Equipment faults should be recorded at the start of the session, before food preparation begins. Additional storage outside the booked period requires agreement. A cupboard left full after the session is not an automatic extension of the booking.

passages.title: Staff survey interpretation · Document 1
passages.text:
MANAGEMENT NOTE
The latest staff survey has a higher satisfaction average than last year's. However, response rates differ substantially between departments, and several small teams had no respondents. Please review participation alongside the average before describing the result as representative of every employee. The people team will invite missing teams to a separate listening session. Those comments will add context rather than being retroactively counted as original survey responses.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R75 · Document 1
passages.text:
E-MAIL
From: Information Security
To: All Employees
Subject: Security Simulation Follow-up

Last Tuesday's simulated phishing message was opened by 38% of staff, but only 7% entered information on the practice page. The exercise was not designed to identify individuals; department-level results will be used to plan short workshops. Managers will receive a topic summary, not employee names. Because several staff members reported the message only after asking a colleague, the first workshop will focus on how to use the reporting button immediately, even when a message merely seems unusual.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R83 · Document 1
passages.text:
Invitation

The City Business Alliance invites local store owners to attend a breakfast forum on April 9. The forum will focus on how small businesses can use customer data responsibly while improving online services. A privacy consultant will explain new consent requirements, and two retailers will describe how they redesigned loyalty programs after receiving customer feedback. Attendance is free, but seating is limited to one representative per business. Participants will receive a worksheet for reviewing their own data-collection practices.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R99 · Document 1
passages.text:
DOCUMENT 1 - INVOICE #C-771

Monthly platform plan: $240
Four additional user seats: $60
Priority support: $40
Service subtotal: $340
Reliability credit: -$34
Amount due: $306

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R99 · Document 2
passages.text:
DOCUMENT 2 - RELIABILITY POLICY

When a single verified outage exceeds two continuous hours, customers receive a credit equal to 10 percent of that month's service subtotal. Credits appear automatically on the next invoice.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R99 · Document 3
passages.text:
DOCUMENT 3 - E-MAIL

From: Accounts Team
To: Morgan Lee

The monitoring report confirms that your workspace was unavailable for two hours and eighteen minutes on May 6. No action is required to receive the applicable credit. Please contact us only if the amount does not appear on invoice #C-771.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R39 · Document 1
passages.text:
NOTICE
Beginning August 1, the cafeteria will accept employee badge payments only. Cash payments will no longer be processed at the register. Employees who want to set a weekly spending limit may do so through the employee portal.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R39 · Document 2
passages.text:
E-MAIL
From: Human Resources
To: All Staff
Subject: Cafeteria Badge Payments

The new payment system is intended to shorten lines during lunch hours. If your badge does not work at the cafeteria register, please visit Human Resources before 11 A.M. so that the issue can be fixed before the lunch rush. Contractors and visitors may still purchase meal vouchers at the reception desk.

passages.title: Display stand substitution · Document 1
passages.text:
SUPPLY POLICY
Standard display stands cost$45 each. Heavy-duty stands cost$60 and require customer approval if substituted. Orders of five or more standard stands receive a10 percent discount on those stands only. Delivery is$20 per order. Out-of-stock items are not substituted automatically.

passages.title: Display stand substitution · Document 2
passages.text:
From: Vera Lin
We need six standard stands for a workshop next Thursday. Please confirm the total including delivery. If the standard model is unavailable, do not send heavy-duty ones without asking; the room layout was planned around the smaller bases.

passages.title: Display stand substitution · Document 3
passages.text:
To: Vera Lin
Four standard stands are in stock; two more will arrive Monday. We can hold the four and dispatch all six Tuesday for Wednesday delivery. No substitution is needed. Your standard-stand discount applies to all six, and the delivery fee remains unchanged. Please confirm that Wednesday receipt is suitable.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R60 · Document 1
passages.text:
Job Posting

Northgate Medical Supply seeks a Customer Training Specialist to teach clinic staff how to use our inventory software. The position requires experience explaining technical processes to nontechnical audiences. Travel to client locations is expected twice a month. Applicants should submit a resume and a sample training outline by September 8.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R60 · Document 2
passages.text:
E-mail

To: Hiring Committee
From: Amira Lewis
Subject: Training Specialist Application

I am attaching my resume and a sample outline from a workshop I designed for pharmacy assistants last year. In my current role, I create short videos that explain ordering procedures to clinic receptionists. I can travel regularly, but I would prefer to avoid overnight trips until November because I am completing a local certification program.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R103 · Document 1
passages.text:
DOCUMENT 1 - TRAVEL EXPENSE POLICY

Meals are reimbursed up to $45 per traveler per day. Airport-to-hotel taxi fares are eligible when accompanied by a receipt. Software subscriptions must be charged to the employee's project budget rather than the travel account.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R103 · Document 2
passages.text:
DOCUMENT 2 - CLAIM #T-206

Dinner: $52
Airport-to-hotel taxi: $38 | Receipt attached
One-month transcription subscription: $29
Claim total: $119

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R103 · Document 3
passages.text:

Please reduce the dinner request to the daily limit and move the transcription charge to project A17. The taxi documentation is complete, so that item can remain on the travel claim.
